Notifications

  • 02-12-2026
    Notice regarding public grievance counter timings

    The public grievance counter will remain closed on Saturday for maintenance.

  • 05-12-2026
    ORDER under Section 163 BNSS

    ORDER
    No. 301/Ord/2026
    Dated: 05.12.2026

    In exercise of the powers conferred under Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, I, Commissioner of Police, Delhi, hereby prohibit the assembly of five or more persons and the use of loudspeakers within the limits of New Delhi District, from 08.12.2026 to 12.12.2026 (both days inclusive).

    Commissioner of Police, Delhi

  • 06-12-2026
    ORDER (district)

    ORDER
    No. 12/DCP/NW/2026
    Dated: 06.12.2026

    Under Section 163 BNSS, I, Deputy Commissioner of Police, North West District, hereby prohibit processions and vehicles carrying loudspeakers in the area of North West District w.e.f. 07.12.2026 till 09.12.2026.
